#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'
export GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'
git init -q -b main
git config user.email journey@example.invalid
git config user.name Journey
mkdir -p shop tests
cat > shop/__init__.py <<'EOF'
# package marker
EOF
cat > shop/pricing.py <<'EOF'
# Pricing helpers for the shop.


def line_total(unit_price, qty):
    # Return unit_price * qty rounded to cents.
    return round(unit_price * qty, 2)
EOF
cat > tests/__init__.py <<'EOF'
# package marker
EOF
cat > tests/test_pricing.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

from shop.pricing import line_total


class LineTotalTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_multiplies_price_by_quantity(self):
        self.assertEqual(line_total(2.5, 4), 10.0)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
EOF
echo restore-repo.sh >> .git/info/exclude
git add shop tests
git commit -q -m 'feat: add line_total helper'
